PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-everything-you-need|Payment Gateways]]-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-trap-most-creators|payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Stripe is only available in 46 countries, meaning the vast majority of the world is excluded from its services. PayPal, while more widely accessible, often suspends accounts with little warning, freezing funds for up to 180 days. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle also impose geographical restrictions, which can effectively shut out creators in regions where financial tools are already limited. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure allows you to build your online store using free tools, enabling you to sell plugins without relying on restrictive payment processors.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe's stringent country eligibility criteria prevent many creators from accessing its services, effectively excluding them from a significant market. PayPal's account restrictions can lead to funds being held for extended periods, creating financial uncertainty. Other platforms like Gumroad and Paddle offer limited functionalities in various regions, making it difficult for digital creators to operate effectively. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, is designed to be inclusive, providing a permanent structural alternative that empowers creators to sell directly without the risk of being locked out.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal often charge high transaction fees, which can erode your profit margins. Additionally, the time it takes for payments to clear can be inconsistent, leading to cash flow problems. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have their own fee structures that may not be favorable for creators in restricted countries. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, utilizing NOWPayments, offers lower fees (only 0.5%) and immediate payment confirmations, ensuring that creators receive their earnings quickly and efficiently.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts you in control of your sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Using platforms like Stripe or PayPal means you're subject to their terms and conditions, which can change without notice. This lack of ownership over your sales infrastructure can be risky. In contrast, with sovereign commerce infrastructure, you maintain complete ownership of your store and its data. Automated payment processing and instant product delivery options ensure that transactions are smooth, allowing you to focus on creating rather than managing payment issues.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're in a country where traditional payment processors are unavailable, your best option is to build your store using sovereign commerce infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) can be deployed in just 48 hours and is designed for creators who need a reliable and robust solution. This stack includes all necessary components like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments for seamless operation, making it an ideal choice for anyone looking to sell plugins without the hassle of conventional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, consider using sovereign commerce infrastructure to build your online store. This robust solution enables you to sell digital products directly, bypassing the limitations of traditional payment processors. By using tools like NOWPayments and free hosting options, you can set up your shop quickly and effectively.
Say goodbye to account suspensions and held funds.

For digital creators searching for alternatives to platforms like Stripe and Gumroad, consider exploring the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) as a viable solution. This stack provides a complete framework for selling plugins online without the usual restrictions. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by selecting the components for your sovereign commerce stack. Deploy your website using Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages for free. Integrate your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up your order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Implement NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Load your products and configure delivery options. Finally, ensure you have proper security measures like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured.
